facts.name: Joint First-to-Die Policy Issuance
facts.sentence: Twin Oaks Life Insurance Company issued a joint first-to-die final expense whole life policy.

facts.name: Together Plan Series
facts.sentence: The policy series is called 'Together Plan'.

facts.name: Policy Identification
facts.sentence: The policy number is TO-JFD-2024-21105.

facts.name: Policy Effective Date
facts.sentence: The policy date is February 14, 2024.

facts.name: Policy Form Identification
facts.sentence: The form used for this policy is TO-JFD-WL-2023.

facts.name: State of Issue: Ohio
facts.sentence: The state of issue for this policy is Ohio.

facts.name: Insured A Identified
facts.sentence: Insured Person A is Frances Louise Kowalski.

facts.name: Birthdate of Insured A
facts.sentence: Frances Louise Kowalski's date of birth is April 3, 1952.

facts.name: Issue Age: 71
facts.sentence: Frances Louise Kowalski’s issue age at time of policy issuance is 71 years old.

facts.name: Female Insured Person
facts.sentence: Frances Louise Kowalski is female.

facts.name: Thaddeus Kowalski Identified
facts.sentence: Insured Person B is Thaddeus George Kowalski.

facts.name: Thaddeus Kowalski DOB
facts.sentence: Thaddeus George Kowalski's date of birth is December 19, 1949.

facts.name: Issue Age: 74
facts.sentence: Thaddeus George Kowalski’s issue age at time of policy issuance is 74 years old.

facts.name: Male Insured Person
facts.sentence: Thaddeus George Kowalski is male.

facts.name: Joint Life Coverage
facts.sentence: Both insured persons' lives are covered under this policy.

facts.name: Joint Policy Ownership
facts.sentence: The owner of the policy is Frances Louise Kowalski and Thaddeus George Kowalski, held jointly.

facts.name: First-to-Die Payout Amount
facts.sentence: The face amount payable upon the first death is $12,000.

facts.name: Monthly Premium Amount
facts.sentence: The monthly joint premium is $198.40.

facts.name: Monthly EFT Payments
facts.sentence: Premiums are paid via electronic funds transfer (EFT).

facts.name: Monthly Premium Due Date
facts.sentence: Premium payments occur on the 14th day of each month.

facts.name: Simplified Issue Underwriting
facts.sentence: This policy uses simplified issue underwriting based on answers to health questions from both insured individuals.

facts.name: Survivor Benefit Rule
facts.sentence: The primary beneficiary is the surviving insured person—the spouse who does not die first.

facts.name: Contingent Beneficiary Designation
facts.sentence: The contingent beneficiary is Monika Anne Kow.

facts.name: Single Policy for Two Lives
facts.sentence: This is a single policy covering two lives.

facts.name: Death Benefit Amount
facts.sentence: The death benefit amount is $12,000.

facts.name: First Death Payout Rule
facts.sentence: The death benefit is paid once, upon the first death of either Insured A or Insured B.

facts.name: Order of Death Determines Payout
facts.sentence: The order of death determines which insured dies first.

facts.name: Policy Termination Post-Payout
facts.sentence: After the first death claim is paid, the policy terminates.

facts.name: Survivor Receives Full Benefit
facts.sentence: The surviving spouse receives the $12,000 benefit.

facts.name: Post-first-death premium cessation
facts.sentence: No further premiums are collected after the first death.

facts.name: Survivorship Rule for Simultaneous Deaths
facts.sentence: If both Insureds die within 30 days of each other, the company treats the elder Insured as having died first.

facts.name: Elder Insured Identified
facts.sentence: The elder Insured is named Thaddeus.

facts.name: Survivorship Payout Rule
facts.sentence: When both Insureds die within 30 days of each other, the contingent beneficiary receives $12,000.

facts.name: Contingent Beneficiary Designation
facts.sentence: The contingent beneficiary is Monika Anne Kowalski.

facts.name: Daughter Designated as Contingent Beneficiary
facts.sentence: Monika Anne Kowalski is designated as the daughter of the insureds.

facts.name: Survivorship Benefit Entitlement
facts.sentence: Monika Anne Kowalski is entitled to 100% of the benefit under the survivorship provision.

facts.name: Simplified-Issue Policy Basis
facts.sentence: This policy was issued on a simplified-issue basis.

facts.name: Graded Benefit Based on Cause
facts.sentence: A graded benefit schedule applies based on the cause of death.

facts.name: Illness Benefit Calculation Year 1
facts.sentence: For policy year 1, before February 14, 2025, the death benefit due to illness/disease is $4,800 plus premiums paid.

facts.name: Accident Benefit – Year 1
facts.sentence: For policy year 1, before February 14, 2025, the death benefit due to accident is $12,000.

facts.name: Accident Benefit Full Payout
facts.sentence: For policy year 1, before February 14, 2025, the death benefit due to accident equals the full benefit.

facts.name: Illness Benefit: Year 1 Payout
facts.sentence: Death from illness/disease results in a benefit of $4,800 during Policy Year 1.

facts.name: Graduated Benefit Percentage
facts.sentence: The $4,800 benefit for death from illness/disease in Policy Year 1 represents 40% of the full benefit.

facts.name: Premiums Included in Illness Benefit
facts.sentence: Premiums paid are included in the death benefit for death from illness/disease in Policy Year 1.

facts.name: Accident Benefit Amount
facts.sentence: Death from accident results in a benefit of $12,000 during Policy Year 1.

facts.name: Accidental Death Benefit Amount
facts.sentence: $12,000 is the full benefit amount for death from accident in Policy Year 1.

facts.name: Illness Benefit in Year 2
facts.sentence: Death from illness/disease results in a benefit of $8,400 during Policy Year 2.

facts.name: 70% Benefit in Year 2
facts.sentence: The $8,400 benefit for death from illness/disease in Policy Year 2 represents 70% of the full benefit.

facts.name: Premiums Included in Disease Benefit
facts.sentence: Premiums paid are included in the death benefit for death from illness/disease in Policy Year 2.

facts.name: Accident Benefit in Year 2
facts.sentence: Death from accident results in a benefit of $12,000 during Policy Year 2.

facts.name: Full Accidental Death Benefit
facts.sentence: $12,000 is the full benefit amount for death from accident in Policy Year 2.

facts.name: Full Benefit Coverage Post-Year 3
facts.sentence: After Policy Year 3, beginning February 14, 2026, death from any cause results in a benefit of $12,000.

facts.name: Full Benefit After Year 3
facts.sentence: $12,000 is the full benefit amount for death from any cause in Policy Year 3 and thereafter.

facts.name: Definition of Accident
facts.sentence: An 'accident' is defined as a sudden, unforeseen, external event.

facts.name: Accident Definition Criteria
facts.sentence: An 'accident' causes bodily injury that leads to death within 90 days.

facts.name: Accident Independence Clause
facts.sentence: An 'accident' must occur independently of illness or disease.

facts.name: Survivor Conversion Option
facts.sentence: If the first insured dies in Policy Year 3 or later, the surviving insured may exercise a one-time conversion option.

facts.name: Survivor Conversion Eligibility
facts.sentence: The survival conversion option applies only when the first death occurs after the graded period.

facts.name: Survivor Conversion Window
facts.sentence: The surviving insured has 90 days from the date of the first death claim payment to convert.

facts.name: Conversion Benefit Limit
facts.sentence: The new individual policy resulting from conversion may have a face amount up to $12,000.

facts.name: Guaranteed Conversion Right
facts.sentence: Conversion does not require new evidence of insurability.

facts.name: No Health Questions on Conversion
facts.sentence: Conversion does not involve health questions.

facts.name: Guaranteed Conversion Right
facts.sentence: The conversion right is a guaranteed conversion right.

facts.name: Conversion Pricing Based on Attained Age
facts.sentence: The new policy is priced at the surviving insured’s attained age at the time of conversion.

facts.name: Guaranteed-Issue Conversion
facts.sentence: The converted policy is a standard guaranteed-issue final expense policy.

facts.name: Converted Policy Graded Period
facts.sentence: The converted policy is subject to a new 2-year graded benefit period.

facts.name: Survivor Conversion Age Limit
facts.sentence: The surviving insured must be age 85 or younger at the time of conversion.

facts.name: Joint Monthly Premium Amount
facts.sentence: The joint monthly premium is $198.40.

facts.name: Joint Premium Coverage
facts.sentence: The joint monthly premium reflects both lives.

facts.name: Fixed Monthly Premium
facts.sentence: The joint monthly premium will never increase as long as the policy is in force.

facts.name: Joint Premium Obligation
facts.sentence: Premiums are the joint obligation of both Owners.

facts.name: Owners Are Both Insureds
facts.sentence: Both Insureds are considered Owners.

facts.name: Joint Premium Payment Authority
facts.sentence: Either Owner may make premium payments.

facts.name: Grace Period Duration
facts.sentence: The grace period is 31 days from the due date.

facts.name: Grace Period Coverage Continuity
facts.sentence: Coverage on both lives continues during the grace period.

facts.name: Policy Split Upon Divorce
facts.sentence: If the Insureds legally divorce, either Owner may request a policy split.

facts.name: Policy Split Requirements
facts.sentence: A policy split requires written notice and a divorce decree.

facts.name: Divorce Policy Split Timeline
facts.sentence: The Company will respond within 60 days of receiving written notice and a divorce decree.

facts.name: Divorce Policy Split Offer
facts.sentence: After a divorce, the Company will offer each former spouse an individual policy.

facts.name: Policy Split Based on Attained Age
facts.sentence: Each individual policy is issued at the respective attained age of the former spouse.

facts.name: Post-Divorce Policy Split Without Health Questions
facts.sentence: No new health questions are required when issuing individual policies post-divorce.

facts.name: Policy Split Face Amount Limit
facts.sentence: The total face amount of the two individual policies cannot exceed $12,000.

facts.name: Policy Termination After Split
facts.sentence: The original joint policy terminates after the policy split.

facts.name: Annual Payment Amount
facts.sentence: Annual payment is $2,341.20.

facts.name: Annual Payment Benefit
facts.sentence: The annual payment option involves paying for 11 months and getting 1 month free.

facts.name: Single Cash Value Accumulation
facts.sentence: This joint policy accumulates a single cash value.

facts.name: No Separate Cash Values
facts.sentence: There are no separate cash values per life in this policy.

facts.name: Guaranteed Cash Value at Year 2
facts.sentence: Guaranteed cash value at end of Year 2 is $1,200.

facts.name: Guaranteed Cash Value at Year 5
facts.sentence: Guaranteed cash value at end of Year 5 is $3,800.

facts.name: Guaranteed Cash Value at Year 10
facts.sentence: Guaranteed cash value at end of Year 10 is $7,500.

facts.name: Policy Loan Authority
facts.sentence: Either Owner may request a policy loan.

facts.name: Loan Limit Based on Cash Value
facts.sentence: Policy loans can be up to 85% of the net cash value.

facts.name: Loan Interest Rate
facts.sentence: Policy loans carry an annual interest rate of 6.0%.

facts.name: Maximum Loan Limit
facts.sentence: The maximum policy loan available is 85% of the net cash value.

facts.name: Policy Loan Interest Rate
facts.sentence: The annual interest rate for a policy loan is 6.0%.

facts.name: Owner Loan Rights
facts.sentence: Either Owner may request a policy loan.

facts.name: Policy Loan Approval Requirement
facts.sentence: A policy loan requires approval from the lender institution.

facts.name: Owner Surrender Right
facts.sentence: Either Owner may surrender the policy.

facts.name: Policy Surrender Consent
facts.sentence: Surrendering the policy requires the written consent of the other Owner.

facts.name: Equal Cash Value Distribution
facts.sentence: Upon surrender, the net cash value is paid equally to both Owners.

facts.name: Discretionary Surrender Distribution
facts.sentence: Both Owners may direct payment distribution differently than equal shares upon surrender.

facts.name: Reduced Paid-Up Default
facts.sentence: If premiums lapse after the policy has cash value, the default nonforfeiture option is Reduced Paid-Up.

facts.name: Reduced Paid-Up Coverage
facts.sentence: Under the Reduced Paid-Up option, both lives remain insured.

facts.name: Reduced Paid-Up Outcome
facts.sentence: The Reduced Paid-Up option results in a reduced joint face amount.

facts.name: Reduced Paid-Up Coverage
facts.sentence: No further premiums are due under the Reduced Paid-Up option.

facts.name: Extended Term Option
facts.sentence: An alternative nonforfeiture option is Extended Term.

facts.name: Extended Term Coverage
facts.sentence: Under the Extended Term option, both lives are covered for the full $12,000 face amount.

facts.name: Extended Term Duration
facts.sentence: The Extended Term coverage lasts for a limited additional period.

facts.name: Suicide Exclusion Clause
facts.sentence: If either Insured dies by suicide within 24 months of the Policy Date, only premiums paid are returned.

facts.name: Suicide Exclusion Continuity
facts.sentence: If the suicide exclusion applies, the policy remains in force on the surviving Insured’s life.

facts.name: Suicide Exclusion End Timing
facts.sentence: The suicide exclusion period ends when the 24-month window passes for the surviving Insured.

facts.name: Simultaneous Death Handling
facts.sentence: Simultaneous death is handled according to Section 1.3.

facts.name: Contestability Period Duration
facts.sentence: Contestability applies for 24 months from the Policy Date for either life.

facts.name: Policy Incontestability After 24 Months
facts.sentence: After 24 months from the Policy Date, the policy becomes incontestable.

facts.name: Contestability Beyond 24 Months
facts.sentence: The policy remains contestable beyond 24 months only for non-payment of premium.

facts.name: No War Exclusions
facts.sentence: There are no exclusions for war-related deaths.

facts.name: Aviation Exclusion Absence
facts.sentence: There are no exclusions for aviation-related deaths.

facts.name: Travel Death Exclusions Absent
facts.sentence: There are no exclusions for travel-related deaths.

facts.name: Joint First-to-Die Policy
facts.sentence: The policy is a Joint First-to-Die policy.

facts.name: First Death Benefit
facts.sentence: The policy pays one benefit upon the first death.

facts.name: Policy termination post-payment
facts.sentence: After the benefit is paid, the policy terminates.

facts.name: Survivor Conversion Option Details
facts.sentence: Section 3 contains information about the Survivor Conversion Option.

facts.name: Free Look Period Duration
facts.sentence: The Free Look period lasts 30 days from delivery.

facts.name: Free Look Refund Policy
facts.sentence: During the Free Look period, a full refund of premiums is available.

facts.name: Primary Beneficiary Rule
facts.sentence: The primary beneficiary is the surviving spouse.

facts.name: Contingent Benefit Trigger
facts.sentence: The contingent beneficiary receives the benefit if both insured individuals die simultaneously.

facts.name: Divorce Split Location
facts.sentence: Divorce Split provisions are detailed in Section 4.4.

facts.name: Claim Documentation Requirement
facts.sentence: The surviving Insured or the Contingent Beneficiary must submit a certified death certificate of the deceased Insured.

facts.name: Claim Submission Requirement
facts.sentence: The surviving Insured or the Contingent Beneficiary must submit a completed claim form.

facts.name: Claim Processing Timeline
facts.sentence: Valid claims are processed and paid by the Company within 7 business days.

facts.name: Claim Inquiry Contact
facts.sentence: Claim inquiries can be made via phone at 1-800-TWIN-OAK.

facts.name: Claim Submission Address
facts.sentence: Mail-in claims should be sent to P.O. Box 2014, Columbus, OH 43202.

facts.name: Home Office Address
facts.sentence: The home office address of Twin Oaks Life Insurance Company is 300 E. Broad Street, Columbus, Ohio 43215.

facts.name: Customer Service Contact
facts.sentence: Customer service for Twin Oaks Life Insurance Company can be reached at 1-800-894-6625.

facts.name: CEO Signature Line
facts.sentence: The CEO signature line appears on the document.

facts.name: Document Signing Date
facts.sentence: The date on which the document was signed is February 14, 2024.

facts.name: Termination Process
facts.sentence: Termination occurs.

facts.name: Survivor Conversion Location
facts.sentence: Information regarding the Survivor Conversion Option is located in Section 3.

facts.sentence: The Lodge Dues amount is $6.00.

facts.name: Monthly EFT Payment Method
facts.sentence: Payments can be made via Monthly EFT on the 1st of the month.

facts.name: In-Person Payment Option
facts.sentence: Payments can also be made in person at Lodge #47.

facts.name: Fraternal Benefit Society Status
facts.sentence: The Order of the American Hearth is a fraternal benefit society.

facts.name: Organizational Legal Basis
facts.sentence: The Order of the American Hearth is organized under Chapter 632 of the Ohio Revised Code.

facts.name: Order Recognition Status
facts.sentence: The Order of the American Hearth is recognized in all states where it operates.

facts.name: Annual Officer Voting Rights
facts.sentence: As a member, you have the right to vote for Lodge #47 officers annually.

facts.name: Annual Officer Elections Responsibility
facts.sentence: As a member, you have the responsibility to participate in Lodge #47 officer elections annually.

facts.name: Member Participation Rights
facts.sentence: As a member, you have the right to participate in Lodge charitable programs.

facts.name: Member Social Program Rights
facts.sentence: As a member, you have the right to participate in Lodge social programs.

facts.name: Member-Only Benefits Access
facts.sentence: As a member, you have access to member-only benefits described in Section 7.

facts.name: Certificate Validity Condition
facts.sentence: This certificate remains in force only while the Member is in good standing with Lodge #47.

facts.name: Good Standing Requirement
facts.sentence: Good standing with Lodge #47 requires payment of all fees.

facts.name: Lodge Good Standing Requirement
facts.sentence: Good standing with Lodge #47 requires compliance with the Laws of the Order.

facts.name: Certificate Termination via Suspension
facts.sentence: Suspension from the Order terminates this certificate.

facts.name: Certificate Termination via Expulsion
facts.sentence: Expulsion from the Order terminates this certificate.

facts.name: Non-Forfeiture Benefits Continuity
facts.sentence: Non-forfeiture benefits described in Section 6 remain available even if the Member's lodge standing lapses after Year 3.

facts.name: Non-Forfeiture Benefit Continuity
facts.sentence: Non-forfeiture benefits described in Section 6 remain available so long as fees are current.

facts.name: Guaranteed-Issue Basis
facts.sentence: This certificate is issued on a guaranteed-issue basis.

facts.name: Guaranteed-Issue Membership
facts.sentence: No health questions were required for membership.

facts.name: Graded Death Benefit Schedule
facts.sentence: The death benefit is graded based on the year of death relative to specific date ranges.

facts.name: Year 1 Non-Accidental Death Benefit
facts.sentence: For Year 1 (before July 1, 2025), non-accidental death results in all fees paid being returned plus 5% interest.

facts.name: Accidental Death Benefit: Year 1
facts.sentence: For Year 1 (before July 1, 2025), accidental death results in a $10,000 benefit.

facts.name: Year 2 Non-Accidental Death Benefit
facts.sentence: For Year 2 (July 1, 2025 – June 30, 2026), non-accidental death results in a $5,000 benefit, which is 50% of the full benefit.

facts.name: Accidental Death Benefit: Year 2
facts.sentence: For Year 2 (July 1, 2025 – June 30, 2026), accidental death results in a $10,000 benefit.

facts.name: Uniform Death Benefit Post-Year 3
facts.sentence: For Year 3 and beyond (July 1, 2026 and thereafter), all deaths result in a $10,000 benefit regardless of cause.

facts.name: Supreme Lodge Authority
facts.sentence: The Order's Supreme Lodge may invoke the Assessment Provision during extraordinary circumstances.

facts.name: Pandemic Trigger
facts.sentence: Extraordinary circumstances include pandemics or catastrophic loss events.

facts.name: Assessment Provision Replacement
facts.sentence: The Assessment Provision may be used in place of the standard death benefit.

facts.name: Assessment Provision Dormancy
facts.sentence: The Assessment Provision has not been invoked in 47 years.

facts.name: Assessment Provision Limitation
facts.sentence: The Assessment Provision is reserved for extreme circumstances only.

facts.name: Actuarial Reserve Sufficiency
facts.sentence: The Order of the American Hearth maintains actuarially adequate reserves to pay all benefits in full.

facts.name: Legal Disclosure Requirement
facts.sentence: Fraternal benefit society law requires disclosure of potential assessments.

facts.name: Reserve Threshold Trigger
facts.sentence: If the Order's reserves fall below 90% of minimum statutory requirements, the Supreme Lodge Board may impose a special assessment.

facts.name: Regulatory Approval for Assessments
facts.sentence: A special assessment on all members requires regulatory approval.

facts.name: Reserve Shortfall Triggers Assessment
facts.sentence: The Order's reserves falling below 90% of minimum statutory requirements triggers a potential special assessment.

facts.name: Special Assessment Trigger
facts.sentence: The Supreme Lodge Board may impose a special assessment on all members when reserves fall below 90% of minimum statutory requirements.

facts.name: Special Assessment Approval Requirement
facts.sentence: A special assessment requires prior regulatory approval.

facts.name: Maximum Assessment Limit
facts.sentence: A special assessment cannot exceed three additional monthly fee payments per year.

facts.name: Special Assessment Purpose
facts.sentence: The purpose of a special assessment is to restore reserve adequacy.

facts.name: Alternative Benefit Reduction
facts.sentence: As an alternative to imposing a special assessment, the Supreme Lodge may proportionally reduce benefits.

facts.name: Benefit Reduction Condition
facts.sentence: Benefits reduction under Section 3.2 is contingent upon reserve restoration.

facts.name: Historical Reserve Stability
facts.sentence: The Order has maintained reserves above 120% of statutory minimums continuously since 1952.

facts.name: Legal Reserve Disclosure Requirement
facts.sentence: This disclosure regarding reserve thresholds and assessment authority is mandated by law.

facts.name: Legal Disclosure Requirement
facts.sentence: This provision is disclosed because it is legally required, not because it is expected to occur.

facts.name: Guaranteed Monthly Fee
facts.sentence: Monthly fees are set at $91.00 for the lifetime of this certificate.

facts.name: Guaranteed Monthly Fee
facts.sentence: Monthly fees remain guaranteed at $91.00 for the life of the certificate.

facts.name: Fixed Fee Guarantee Exception
facts.sentence: The guarantee of fixed monthly fees applies except as modified by Section 3.

facts.name: Grace Period for Fees
facts.sentence: There is a 31-day grace period for payment of fees.

facts.name: Grace Period Coverage Continuity
facts.sentence: Coverage remains active during the 31-day grace period.

facts.name: Annual Fee Option
facts.sentence: An annual fee option exists at $1,056.00.

facts.name: Annual Fee Free Month Benefit
facts.sentence: The annual fee option includes one free month.

facts.name: Lodge Dues Included
facts.sentence: Lodge dues of $6.00 are included within the monthly fee of $91.00.

facts.name: Lodge Dues Increase on Role Upgrade
facts.sentence: If a member upgrades their lodge participation, such as taking on an officer role, lodge dues may increase independently.

facts.name: Insurance Charge Fixed at $85
facts.sentence: The insurance charge portion of the monthly fee is $85.00.

facts.name: Guaranteed Insurance Charge
facts.sentence: The insurance charge of $85.00 is guaranteed to remain level throughout the life of the certificate.

facts.name: Reserve Accumulation Similarity
facts.sentence: This certificate accumulates a reserve amount similar to cash value found in commercial insurance policies.

facts.name: Accumulated Reserve at Year 2
facts.sentence: At the end of Year 2, the accumulated reserve value is $470.

facts.name: Accumulated Reserve Value at Year 5
facts.sentence: At the end of Year 5, the accumulated reserve value is $1,550.

facts.name: Unspecified Reserve Value Year 1
facts.sentence: At the end of Year 1, the accumulated reserve value is unspecified in the given text.

facts.name: Reserve Value at Year 2
facts.sentence: End of Year 2 reserve value is $470.

facts.name: Reserve Value at Year 5
facts.sentence: End of Year 5 reserve value is $1,550.

facts.name: Reserve Value at Year 10
facts.sentence: End of Year 10 reserve value is $3,800.

facts.name: Loan Limit Based on Reserve Value
facts.sentence: A Member may borrow up to 80% of the reserve value.

facts.name: Certificate Loan Interest Rate
facts.sentence: Certificate loans carry a 5.5% annual interest rate.

facts.name: Certificate Surrender Value
facts.sentence: A Member may surrender the certificate for its net reserve value.

facts.name: Certificate Surrender Rights
facts.sentence: A Member may surrender the certificate at any time.

facts.name: Reduced Paid-Up Certificate
facts.sentence: After Year 3, if the Member stops paying fees, the default option is a Reduced Paid-Up Certificate.

facts.name: Reduced Paid-Up Benefit
facts.sentence: A Reduced Paid-Up Certificate maintains a proportional benefit amount based on the reserve value.

facts.name: Reduced Paid-Up Coverage
facts.sentence: A Reduced Paid-Up Certificate remains in force with no further fees.

facts.name: Membership Lapse Condition
facts.sentence: Lodge membership may separately lapse if dues are not paid.

facts.name: Lodge Social Gatherings Access
facts.sentence: Members have access to Lodge #47 weekly social gatherings.

facts.name: Access to Holiday Events
facts.sentence: Members have access to Lodge #47 holiday events.

facts.name: Lodge Community Service Access
facts.sentence: Members have access to Lodge #47 community service activities.

facts.name: Member Assistance Fund Benefit
facts.sentence: The Member Assistance Fund offers emergency financial assistance.

facts.name: Member Assistance Cap
facts.sentence: Emergency financial assistance through the Member Assistance Fund is capped at $500 per calendar year.

facts.name: Board Approval Requirement
facts.sentence: Emergency financial assistance through the Member Assistance Fund requires Lodge #47 Board approval.

facts.name: Scholarship Eligibility for Grandchildren
facts.sentence: Eligible grandchildren of members may apply to the Order's annual scholarship program.

facts.name: Scholarship Award Amount
facts.sentence: The Order's annual scholarship program awards $1,500 per recipient.

facts.name: Competitive Scholarship Program
facts.sentence: The Order's annual scholarship program is competitive.

facts.name: Annual Scholarship Program
facts.sentence: The Order offers an annual scholarship program.

facts.name: Scholarship Award Amount
facts.sentence: Each scholarship award amounts to $1,500.

facts.name: Competitive Scholarship Award
facts.sentence: The scholarship program is competitive.

facts.name: Chaplaincy Program Access
facts.sentence: Members have access to the Order's chaplaincy program.

facts.name: Chaplaincy Hospital Visits
facts.sentence: The chaplaincy program includes hospital visits.

facts.name: Chaplaincy Pastoral Care
facts.sentence: The chaplaincy program provides pastoral care.

facts.name: Expulsion and Benefit Forfeiture
facts.sentence: A member who is expelled from the Order for cause forfeits all insurance benefits.

facts.name: Expulsion Consequences
facts.sentence: A member who is expelled from the Order for cause forfeits all non-insurance benefits.

facts.name: Definition of Conduct Unbecoming
facts.sentence: Conduct unbecoming is defined in the Laws of the Order.

facts.name: Expulsion With Long-Term Fee Payment
facts.sentence: If a member has paid fees for three or more years and is expelled, they retain the non-insurance right to receive the net reserve value in cash.

facts.name: Surrender Benefit Definition
facts.sentence: The surrender benefit refers to the net reserve value received in cash upon expulsion.

facts.name: Death Benefit Termination Upon Expulsion
facts.sentence: The death benefit certificate terminates upon expulsion regardless of how long the member had been enrolled.

facts.name: Appeal Rights After Expulsion
facts.sentence: Appeal rights for members expelled are governed by the Laws of the Order.

facts.name: Appeal Rights After Expulsion
facts.sentence: An expelled member has the right to petition the Supreme Lodge.

facts.name: Suicide Fee Refund Policy
facts.sentence: If suicide occurs within 24 months of enrollment, the fees paid are returned.

facts.name: Contestability for Misrepresentation
facts.sentence: Contestability applies for material misrepresentation during application.

facts.name: No Health Questions Asked
facts.sentence: No health questions were asked during the application process.

facts.name: Fraud-Based Contestability Limits
facts.sentence: Contestability is limited to fraud involving identity or age.

facts.name: No War Exclusions
facts.sentence: There are no war exclusions in the policy.

facts.name: No Aviation Exclusions
facts.sentence: There are no aviation exclusions in the policy.

facts.name: No Foreign Travel Exclusions
facts.sentence: There are no foreign travel exclusions in the policy.

facts.name: Claim Processing Authority
facts.sentence: Claims are processed by the Order's Supreme Lodge.

facts.name: Claim Processing Authority
facts.sentence: The Order of the American Hearth’s Supreme Lodge processes claims.

facts.name: Death Certificate Requirement
facts.sentence: A certified death certificate is required to process a claim.

facts.name: Claim Form Requirement
facts.sentence: A completed claim form is required to process a claim.

facts.name: Membership Confirmation Requirement
facts.sentence: Lodge membership confirmation from Lodge #47 Secretary is required to process a claim.

facts.name: Phone Claim Inquiries
facts.sentence: Claim inquiries can be made via phone at 1-800-OAH-CARE.

facts.name: Claim Submission Address
facts.sentence: Claims can be submitted to the Supreme Lodge at P.O. Box 1899, Columbus, OH 43201.

facts.name: Claim Submission Email
facts.sentence: Claims can be emailed to claims@orderoftheamericanhearth.org.

facts.name: Official Website Address
facts.sentence: The website for the Order of the American Hearth is www.orderoftheamericanhearth.org.

facts.name: Motto of the Order
facts.sentence: The motto of the Order of the American Hearth is 'Together in Life. Together in Legacy.'

facts.name: Supreme Secretary Signature
facts.sentence: The Supreme Secretary of the Order of the American Hearth signed the document on July 1, 2024.

facts.name: Supreme Secretary Signature
facts.sentence: The signature of the Supreme Secretary appears on the document.

facts.name: Supreme Secretary Signing Date
facts.sentence: The date of signing by the Supreme Secretary is July 1, 2024.

facts.name: Lodge Master Attestation
facts.sentence: The Master of Prairie Wind Lodge #47 attested to the document.

facts.name: Master's Attestation Signature
facts.sentence: The attestation signature of the Master of Prairie Wind Lodge #47 appears on the document.

facts.name: Fraternal Benefit vs Insurance
facts.sentence: A fraternal benefit certificate issued by the Order of the American Hearth is not a commercial insurance policy.

facts.name: Governance by Order Laws
facts.sentence: Benefits provided under the fraternal benefit certificate are governed by the Laws of the Order.

facts.sentence: The policy date is September 1, 2024.

facts.name: Product Form Identifier

facts.name: Single Premium Coverage
facts.sentence: The premium type for the policy is Single Premium, requiring only one payment for lifetime coverage.

facts.name: State of Issue: Florida

facts.name: Insured Person Identified

facts.sentence: Beatrice Helene Fontaine's date of birth is March 30, 1949.

facts.name: Policy Owner Identity
facts.sentence: The owner of the policy is Beatrice Helene Fontaine.

facts.name: Primary Beneficiary Allocation
facts.sentence: The primary beneficiary of the policy is Michel André Fontaine, who receives 60% of the death benefit.

facts.name: Secondary Primary Beneficiary Share
facts.sentence: Claire Fontaine-Dupre is a secondary primary beneficiary and receives 40% of the death benefit.

facts.name: Son of Insured
facts.sentence: Michel André Fontaine is the son of Beatrice Helene Fontaine.

facts.name: Daughter of Insured
facts.sentence: Claire Fontaine-Dupre is the daughter of Beatrice Helene Fontaine.

facts.name: Contingent Beneficiary Designation
facts.sentence: The contingent beneficiary of the policy is the Estate of Beatrice Helene Fontaine.

facts.name: Contingent Beneficiary Clause
facts.sentence: The contingent beneficiary receives 100% of the death benefit if both primary beneficiaries predecease the insured.

facts.name: Face Amount: $14,000
facts.sentence: The face amount of the life insurance policy is $14,000.

facts.name: Single Premium Amount
facts.sentence: The single premium paid for the policy is $9,800.

facts.name: Single Premium Payment Date
facts.sentence: The single premium was paid in full on September 1, 2024.

facts.name: No Further Premiums Due
facts.sentence: No further premiums are required for the policy after the initial payment.

facts.name: IRR on Death Benefit
facts.sentence: The internal rate of return on the death benefit is approximately 3.1%.

facts.name: IRR Assumption Based on Age 85
facts.sentence: The internal rate of return assumption is based on death occurring at age 85.

facts.name: Illustrative IRR Not Guaranteed
facts.sentence: The assumed internal rate of return is illustrative and not guaranteed.

facts.name: MEC Classification
facts.sentence: This policy is classified as a Modified Endowment Contract (MEC).

facts.name: MEC Classification Basis
facts.sentence: The MEC classification is determined under Internal Revenue Code Section 7702A.

facts.name: Single-Premium Policy Classification
facts.sentence: This policy is a single-premium policy.

facts.name: Failed 7-Pay Test
facts.sentence: The policy failed the '7-pay test' under the Internal Revenue Code.

facts.name: 7-Pay Test Failure → MEC Classification
facts.sentence: Failure of the 7-pay test results in the policy being classified as a MEC.

facts.name: MEC Loan/Withdrawal Taxability
facts.sentence: Loans and withdrawals from a MEC are taxable as ordinary income to the extent of gain in the policy.

facts.name: MEC Loan/Withdrawal Tax Rule
facts.sentence: Taxable amounts from MEC loans and withdrawals occur prior to recovery of basis.

facts.name: MEC vs Non-MEC Withdrawal Tax Treatment
facts.sentence: Non-MEC policies allow recovery of basis before taxation; this does not apply to MECs.

facts.name: 10% Penalty on Early MEC Distributions
facts.sentence: A 10% penalty tax applies to taxable distributions from a MEC taken before the owner reaches age 59½.

facts.name: Tax-Free Death Benefit
facts.sentence: The death benefit paid to beneficiaries is generally income tax-free under IRC §101(a).

facts.name: Tax-Free Death Benefit Regardless of MEC Status
facts.sentence: The tax-free treatment of death proceeds applies regardless of the policy's MEC status.

facts.name: Permanent MEC Status
facts.sentence: The MEC classification of this policy is permanent and cannot be changed.

facts.name: Tax Advisor Recommendation
facts.sentence: The company advises the policy owner to consult a qualified tax advisor before taking any loan or withdrawal.

facts.name: Tax Advice Before Withdrawals
facts.sentence: The Company recommends that the Owner consult a qualified tax advisor before taking any loan or withdrawal from this policy.

facts.name: Single Premium Paid
facts.sentence: The Owner has paid a single premium of $9,800 in full.

facts.name: Fully Paid-Up Policy
facts.sentence: This policy is fully paid-up from the date of issue.

facts.name: No Further Premiums Due
facts.sentence: No additional premiums will ever be required or accepted.

facts.name: No Future Premiums Due
facts.sentence: This policy cannot lapse for non-payment of premium because no further premiums are due.

facts.name: Policy Termination via Surrender
facts.sentence: The policy can terminate through surrender by the Owner.

facts.name: Policy Termination via Death
facts.sentence: The policy can terminate through the death of the Insured.

facts.name: Policy Termination via Loan Interest
facts.sentence: The policy can terminate through exhaustion of cash value by outstanding loan interest.

facts.name: Immediate Death Benefit Payout
facts.sentence: The full Face Amount of $14,000 is payable upon the Insured's death from any cause at any time, from the Policy Date forward.

facts.name: No Graded Benefit Period
facts.sentence: There is no graded benefit period on this policy.

facts.name: Health Review Enables Immediate Benefit
facts.sentence: The Insured provided health answers and was reviewed.

facts.name: Single Premium Paid In Full
facts.sentence: The single premium was paid in full.

facts.name: Immediate Death Benefit
facts.sentence: Full death benefit is immediate on this policy.

facts.name: Guaranteed Death Benefit Floor
facts.sentence: The death benefit will never be less than the Single Premium paid, which is $9,800.

facts.name: Return of Premium Guarantee
facts.sentence: The return of premium floor is guaranteed.

facts.name: Guaranteed Death Benefit Floor
facts.sentence: The death benefit remains at least equal to the Single Premium paid even if the policy has been partially surrendered.

facts.name: Guaranteed Death Benefit Floor
facts.sentence: The death benefit remains at least equal to the Single Premium paid even if there are outstanding loans.

facts.name: Immediate Cash Value Onset
facts.sentence: This policy has immediate cash value from Day 1.

facts.name: Immediate Cash Value Trigger
facts.sentence: The full premium was paid at once.

facts.name: Immediate Cash Value Inception
facts.sentence: Cash value at inception is $9,212.

facts.name: Immediate Cash Value Inception
facts.sentence: Cash value at inception is approximately 94% of the single premium.

facts.name: Guaranteed Cash Value Growth
facts.sentence: Guaranteed cash value growth occurs over time.

facts.name: Year 1 Cash Value
facts.sentence: Cash value at Year 1 is $9,212.

facts.name: Guaranteed Cash Value at Year 3
facts.sentence: Cash value at Year 3 is $9,650.

facts.name: Guaranteed Cash Value at Year 5
facts.sentence: Cash value at Year 5 is $10,300.

facts.name: Guaranteed Cash Value Growth
facts.sentence: Cash value at Year 10 is $11,600.

facts.name: Guaranteed Cash Value at Year 20
facts.sentence: Cash value at Year 20 is $13,100.

facts.name: Cash Value Growth Trend
facts.sentence: Cash value grows slowly but steadily toward the Face Amount.

facts.name: MEC Policy Classification
facts.sentence: This policy is treated as a Modified Endowment Contract (MEC).

facts.name: Net Amount at Risk Definition
facts.sentence: The difference between the Face Amount and cash value at any time represents the net amount at risk.

facts.name: Net Amount at Risk Definition
facts.sentence: The net amount at risk is the pure insurance element.

facts.name: Policy Loan Access
facts.sentence: The owner may borrow up to 90% of net cash value at any time.

facts.name: Loan Interest Rate
facts.sentence: Policy loans accrue interest at 5.0% per year.

facts.name: MEC Loan Taxability
facts.sentence: Loans from this MEC policy are taxable events to the extent of gain.

facts.name: Policy Withdrawal Flexibility
facts.sentence: Withdrawals from this policy are allowed at any time.

facts.name: Partial Surrender Reduces Death Benefit
facts.sentence: Each partial surrender (withdrawal) reduces the death benefit dollar-for-dollar.

facts.name: Minimum Withdrawal Threshold
facts.sentence: Minimum withdrawal amount is $500.

facts.name: Withdrawable Funds Tax Implications
facts.sentence: Withdrawals are taxable events under MEC rules.

facts.name: Full Surrender Rights
facts.sentence: Full surrender of the policy is permitted at any time.

facts.name: Full Surrender Payout
facts.sentence: Upon full surrender, the owner receives the full net cash value.

facts.name: No Surrender Charges
facts.sentence: No surrender charges apply on this policy.

facts.name: Suicide Exclusion Within 24 Months
facts.sentence: The policy excludes coverage for suicide if the insured dies by suicide within 24 months of the Policy Date.

facts.name: Suicide Exclusion Within 24 Months
facts.sentence: If the insured dies by suicide within 24 months of the Policy Date, the death benefit is limited to a return of the Single Premium paid.

facts.name: Single Premium Amount
facts.sentence: The amount of the Single Premium paid is $9,800.

facts.name: Full Death Benefit Eligibility
facts.sentence: After 24 months from the Policy Date, the death benefit applies fully regardless of the cause of death.

facts.name: Contestability Period
facts.sentence: This policy is subject to contestability for 24 months from the Policy Date.

facts.name: Policy Incontestability
facts.sentence: After 24 months from the Policy Date, the policy becomes incontestable.

facts.name: Fraud Exception
facts.sentence: The only exception to the incontestability clause after 24 months is in cases involving fraud.

facts.name: No War Exclusion
facts.sentence: There are no exclusions for war under this policy.

facts.name: No Aviation Exclusions
facts.sentence: There are no exclusions for aviation under this policy.

facts.name: No Foreign Travel Exclusions
facts.sentence: There are no exclusions for foreign travel under this policy.

facts.name: No Hazardous Activity Exclusions
facts.sentence: There are no exclusions for hazardous activities under this policy.

facts.name: Free Look Period
facts.sentence: The Owner has a free look period of 30 days from the date of delivery.

facts.name: Free Look Refund
facts.sentence: During the free look period, the Owner can receive a full refund of the Single Premium if the policy is returned to the Company.

facts.name: Policy Assignment Rights
facts.sentence: The Owner may assign this policy as collateral.

facts.name: Policy Assignment Right
facts.sentence: The Owner may assign this policy by absolute transfer.

facts.name: MEC Assignment Tax Review
facts.sentence: Due to the Modified Endowment Contract (MEC) status of the policy, all assignments should be reviewed with a tax advisor.

facts.name: Change Beneficiary Rights
facts.sentence: The Owner may change the beneficiary at any time.

facts.name: Change Beneficiary Process
facts.sentence: A change of beneficiary requires a written request.

facts.name: Revocable Beneficiary Designation
facts.sentence: The current beneficiary designation is revocable.

facts.name: Policy Portability Across States
facts.sentence: This policy is portable across all U.S. states.

facts.name: Claim Submission Requirement
facts.sentence: To submit a claim, a certified death certificate must be submitted.

facts.name: Claim Submission Requirement
facts.sentence: To submit a claim, a completed claim form must be submitted.

facts.name: Claim Payment Timeline
facts.sentence: Claim payments are made within 5 business days of receiving all required documents.

facts.sentence: Proceeds paid to beneficiaries are generally income-tax-free.
